title: CondoGuard Coverage A Realignment Charge
content:
Underwriting bulletin of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy on bringing Coverage A into line with the tier's minimum, and on the premium for doing so.

**The realignment.** When the master policy type on file makes the tier's Coverage A minimum higher than the Coverage A on the declarations, a Coverage A realignment raises Coverage A to exactly that minimum, and an owner who wants more than the minimum asks for a separate Coverage A change.

**The minimum.** The tier's Coverage A minimum is its bare-walls, single-entity or all-in minimum according to the master policy type shown on the declarations.

**Full-year realignment charge.** The full-year realignment charge is the tier's Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD multiplied by the number of thousands of USD by which the new Coverage A exceeds the Coverage A on the declarations before the change, rounded half-up to the cent. The number of thousands is that excess in USD divided by 1000, without rounding, so an excess of 12,500 USD is 12.5 thousands.

**Charge for the rest of the term.** The realignment charge for the rest of the term is the full-year realignment charge multiplied by the calendar days from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term (the calendar days from the term's effective date to its expiration date), rounded half-up to the cent. The full-year figure is rounded first and the day fraction is applied to the rounded figure. Each rounding of the realignment charge to the cent is half-up in exact decimal: a figure lying exactly halfway between two cents goes to the higher cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Master policy type on the declarations | bare walls |
| Tier bare-walls minimum | 60000 USD |
| Coverage A on the declarations before the change | 47500 USD |
| New Coverage A | 60000 USD, exactly the minimum |
| Excess in thousands | 12500 divided by 1000, 12.5 |
| Tier Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD | 3.29 USD |
| Full-year realignment charge | 3.29 multiplied by 12.5 is 41.125, exactly halfway, which goes to 41.13 USD |
| Days left in a 365-day term | 200 |
| Charge for the rest of the term | 41.13 multiplied by 200 and divided by 365 is 22.5369..., which rounds to 22.54 USD |
